concepts.learning_objective: Identify the order of a matrix and locate its element a_ij by row and column.
Construct a matrix whose elements are given by a rule in i and j, and list the possible orders for a given number of elements.
Classify matrices as row, column, square, diagonal, scalar, identity or zero matrices.
Use the conditions for equality of matrices to find unknown elements.
Add and subtract matrices of the same order and apply the properties of matrix addition.
Multiply a matrix by a scalar and solve simple matrix equations using these operations.
Decide when a product of matrices is defined, find its order and compute it.
Apply the properties of matrix multiplication, including non-commutativity and zero products of non-zero matrices.

topics.title: Transpose, symmetric and skew symmetric matrices

concepts.learning_objective: Find the transpose of a matrix and apply the properties of transpose, including (AB)' = B'A'.
Identify symmetric and skew symmetric matrices and express a square matrix as their sum.
Use the definition AB = BA = I to recognise and verify the inverse of a square matrix.
Apply the uniqueness of the inverse and the result (AB)^(-1) = B^(-1)A^(-1).
